skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental theories and current legal regulations governing economic management, business operations, and commercial activities.
Comprehend legal frameworks for business establishment, management, and dissolution.
Grasp legal regulations for various business entities and their operations.
Understand legal aspects of business contracts and dispute resolution.
Learn methods for resolving business and commercial disputes.
Develop independent research skills and accumulate knowledge.
Apply teamwork skills and effective communication.
Master the ability to present and communicate effectively.
Enhance critical thinking and problem-solving skills in legal contexts.
